jobs.title: Specialist, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

**Specialist:** Software Engineering, Full\-Stack
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology\-driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  

**Role Overview:**  

As a Full\-Stack Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable software solutions across the UI, API, data, and cloud layers that meet business and user needs. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, product managers, and delivery leads to translate functional and non\-functional needs into high\-quality solutions, working both independently as well as part of a global team.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
  

* Develop and maintain complex full\-stack applications and software configurations in collaboration with global cross\-functional teams
* Develop responsive, accessible user interfaces using modern web technologies (e.g., React/Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript/Python)
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices using technologies such as Node.js/Express or equivalent
* Design test cases and test scripts independently, mapping back to pre\-determined criteria, recording and reporting test outcomes
* Ensure quality through automated and manual testing, code reviews, and participation in design and requirements discussions
* Build, deploy, and operate applications on cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure and/or GCP), following cloud\-native best practices
* Use DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring/observability) for versioning, deployment, and release automation
* Leverage modern developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot or similar AI\-assisted development tools) to improve coding efficiency and quality
* Apply secure development practices, including API security, authentication/authorization, and data protection
* Gather requirements and design lifecycle practices and automation for secure, well\-engineered systems and microservices
* Follow Digital SDLC practices, ensuring appropriate documentation, compliance, and governance across all development phases (design, build, test, deploy)
* Participate in Agile delivery processes using tools such as Jira for backlog management, sprint planning, status tracking, and cross\-team collaboration
* Demonstrate awareness of AI capabilities and apply AI\-assisted tools responsibly to enhance development productivity and solution quality
* Contribute to product planning, execution, and delivery within a matrix organization
* Support performance optimization and scalability improvements across applications


**What Should you have:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
* 3–7 years of hands\-on experience working in full\-stack development
* Proficiency in at least one major stack (TypeScript/Node/React, Java, Python, or .NET)
* Knowledge of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, HTTP, REST APIs
* Familiarity with SQL and relational database design (plus practical query optimization)
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS and/or Azure and/or GCP) and cloud\-native concepts (e.g., microservices, containerization, managed services)
* Experience with DevOps practices (Git, infrastructure as code, observability, CI/CD)
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with tools such as Jira or equivalent
* Awareness of AI\-assisted developer tools or emerging AI capabilities in software engineering
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a product and customer\-centric mindset


**Primary Skills:**  

* Proficiency in at least one major stack (TypeScript/JavaScript/Node/React, Java, Python, or .NET).
* Familiarity with SQL and relational database design (plus practical query optimization).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms


**Secondary Skills:** Devops, CI/CD
  
  

**Preferred:**  

* Cloud\-native, AWS/GCP certified
* Familiarity with secure coding and compliance practices
* Basic understanding of Digital SDLC or regulated development lifecycle practices (e.g., documentation, testing, compliance requirements)
* Foundational awareness of AI/GenAI concepts, including prompt engineering basics, RAG patterns, or usage of AI\-assisted tools within the software development lifecycle

We are known as well\-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**

  


At New Relic, we provide our customers real\-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.

The Infrastructure product organization develops New Relic infrastructure instrumentation agents, next generation data processing and management services, vulnerability management, and security testing capabilities for on\-prem and cloud customers. We work with data at a scale using a diverse tech stack (Go, Java, JavaScript, React, GraphQL, Kubernetes, many public cloud web services, and more). As a senior backend engineer, you will help us build and extend next generation solutions such as a control plane for customers to manage their data pipelines at scale.

New Relic is looking for engineers who are interested in building a brand\-new observability experience. This high\-impact engineering position is a phenomenal opportunity to own and build a set of next generation services and capabilities for the company. We are searching for a motivated engineer who is ready for a career\-defining role in their next opportunity. We look forward to talking with you!  

**What you'll do**  

  

* Design, Build, maintain, and scale back\-end services and their support tools.
* Participate in architectural definitions with a high degree of innovation and creativity.
* Creating automation and tooling to make our systems more scalable and easier to deploy.
* Working directly within a multidisciplinary team to help our customers and partners.
* Research new tools and services to understand complex scenarios and to also propose new features.
* Working in an agile environment with a DevOps approach \- teams build and maintain their own software
 **This role requires**

  

* Bachelor’s degree, software development, engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 to 4 years of experience working as a software engineer working in Java and/or Go with a strong computer science background and an aptitude for learning new languages quickly
* Demonstrated experience in designing, developing, and maintaining large\-scale software systems, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks
* Proven ability to mentor a team of software engineers, guiding them towards technical excellence, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality code
* Strong understanding of scalable distributed systems and microservices architecture, with the ability to design and implement solutions that meet performance and scalability requirements.
* Passion for exploring new technologies and finding creative solutions to complex problems, keeping up with industry trends and advancements in observability and related domains
* Excellent collaboration abilities, with the capacity to work effectively with cross\-functional teams, present ideas, and communicate technical concepts clearly
* Keep up to date with technologies \- AWS/Azure/GCP, serverless, Docker, Kubernetes among others.


**Bonus points if you have**

  

* Contribution to open source projects.
* Familiarity with the tech stacks mentioned above
* Understanding the value that build and test automation brings to a development team's efficiency and reliability and are passionate about applying these techniques to your projects.
* Experience in technical mentorship and help with leveling up the skills of other colleagues on the team.
* Experience with asynchronous programming techniques: streams, event\-based flows, task queues, message queues.

Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Advanced Enterprise Data Platform
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure.
* Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long\-term product roadmaps.
* Deep knowledge of AI/ML foundations, RAG, and semantic modeling.
* Ability to define platform success metrics from user feedback while ensuring strict data privacy and security compliance.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Google’s data landscape into an AI\-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high\-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross\-functional domains to drive product\-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Google’s next generation of agentic intelligence.


At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI\-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem.
* Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges.
* Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide\-ranging enterprise requirements.
* Engage directly with domain owners to lead platform adoption, optimize common capabilities, and achieve product\-market fit.
* Define satisfaction metrics through user feedback while navigating ambiguity to maintain enterprise standards and high\-impact delivery.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

We are currently in search of a brilliant, self\-driven, and seasoned BIE II to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on building scalable solutions, including extensive data models and complex ETL pipelines and utilize your expertise to raise the bar on data timeliness, discoverability and availability of the same.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Business Intelligence Engineer at Amazon, you will connect with world leaders in your field working on similar problems. You will be working with massive\-scale data and providing analytic support to product/program managers, engineers using these data. You will utilize your deep expertise in business analysis, metrics, reporting, and analytic tooling/languages like SQL, Excel, Python and others, to translate the data into meaningful insights. You will have ownership of the insights you are building for the business, and will play an integral role in tactical decision\-making for critical risk areas.  

  

Build self\-service tools and dashboard that not only gives aggregated metrics but also provide ways to pull granular data for defect verification, customer communication, deep\-dives, etc.

Mentor teammates, provide inputs in team and org level strategic planning, lead cross org discussions

By tapping into the vast troves of data available, the ISS\-CA team applies their formidable analytical capabilities to extract deep, actionable insights that can inform and optimize the seller experience.  

  

Secondly, the team plays a pivotal role in guiding strategic business decisions through their data\-driven approach. Their work provides the foundation for evidence\-based actions that can propel the platform and its seller ecosystem to new heights of success. Whether it's identifying emerging trends, uncovering hidden growth opportunities, or optimizing operational efficiency, the ISS\-CA team's insights are invaluable in shaping the future direction of the business.  

  

With their cross\-functional expertise and relentless pursuit of innovation, the ISS\-CA team is at the forefront of leveraging the power of data and advanced analytics to revolutionize the way the platform engages with and supports its third\-party seller community.

* 3\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience

* Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2\+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
* Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large\-scale, complex datasets
* Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

**Overview**
 Microsoft Digital (MSD) builds and manages the critical products and services that Microsoft runs on. We boldly pursue big ideas that power transformational advances at Microsoft and for our customers, while helping Microsoft teams work smarter, faster, and more securely every day. Microsoft Digital employees have deep technical and business expertise, customer insights, and a clear point of view that comes from first\-hand, large\-scale experience with Microsoft and industry solutions. We are engineers, technology leaders and experts, digital transformation change agents, and customer advocates.
   

  

 We have exciting opportunities for you to innovate, influence, transform, inspire, and grow within our organization and we encourage you to apply to learn more!
   

  

 Within MSD, the Enterprise Digital Asset Platform (eDAP) is the team that keeps Microsoft's own digital workplace safe and well organized. Every day people here create millions of things: team sites, shared files, chat spaces, databases, apps, and now AI agents that act on their own. Each one needs someone responsible for it, the right privacy setting, the right people with access, and a sensible point at which it gets cleaned up. Across an estate this size is countless hours of manual work in a traditional enterprise, and it still falls behind. This is where eDAP comes in.
   

  

 Our platform does that tracking instead. It continuously watches for problems, works out which ones genuinely matter, and either fixes them automatically or brings the owner one clear recommendation they can approve in a single click. We are building it so that staying secure feels like something the company handles for you, rather than another job on your list.
   

  

 We have exciting opportunities for you to innovate, influence, transform, inspire, and grow within our organization, and we encourage you to apply to learn more.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. About the Role
  
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering\& Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations.

We operate in small agile teams (e.g., \~6 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. Rather than being a narrowly specialized Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or MLOps Engineer, you will combine these skill sets. This role involves working deeply with multimodal foundation models, advanced agentic workflows (including Agent\-to\-Agent/A2A communication), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, other emerging AI technologies, and MLOps subsystems. jobs.description:
Reviews, analyzes, and documents business systems and user needs. Provides system set\-up, technical designs, and test planning. Tests and maintains systems and applications.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Join Vanguard's VISCO team and help shape the future of workflow and case management solutions built on the Appian platform. In this role, you will partner with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to define product vision, gather requirements, prioritize features, and deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency and crew experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define objectives, and identify opportunities for process automation and workflow optimization.
* Elicit, document, and manage business, functional, and non\-functional requirements for Appian\-based solutions.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, translating business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Appian developers and architects to define solution designs and ensure alignment with business goals.
* Lead requirements workshops, process mapping sessions, and stakeholder reviews.
* Support testing, user acceptance activities, releases, and post\-production adoption.
* Analyze operational metrics and user feedback to continuously improve product capabilities.
* Ensure solutions align with Vanguard's architecture, security, risk, and compliance standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Process Improvement.
* Experience gathering requirements and documenting business processes, user stories, and functional specifications.
* Strong understanding of workflow, case management, or business process management concepts.
* Experience working in Agile product delivery teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Appian, BPM, workflow, or case management platforms.
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, Visio, and process modeling tools.
* Exposure to AI, intelligent automation, RPA, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience prioritizing product roadmaps and managing backlogs.
* CBAP, PMI\-PBA, CSPO, or similar business analysis/product management certification.


**What You'll Bring**
* Strong customer and business outcome focus.
* Ability to bridge business and technology teams effectively.
* Passion for process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic thinking combined with strong execution and organizational skills.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 ICE is seeking a Business Analyst to support the market surveillance technology used by its derivative exchanges. This is an exciting opportunity to join ICE and work within its exchanges business; the successful candidate will be a pivotal and noteworthy intermediary between business and technology and will have unrivaled transparency into the fundamentals of both domains.
   

  

 The individual will also be responsible for traditional business analyst activities, such as eliciting business and product requirements to then produce system requirements including functional specifications, use\-cases, and logical flow modeling. The Business Analyst’s role is vital in the creation and ongoing ownership of documentation for our Development and Quality Assurance teams to efficiently undertake their responsibilities; as such, the successful candidate will be expected to become a subject matter expert on market surveillance technology, assisting in all facets of the SDLC whilst interacting with and supporting end users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Engage and work with stakeholders to understand their processes and requirements.
* Provide end users with product support to facilitate their daily activities and responsibilities; where necessary, prepare and provide training sessions and presentations.
* Work independently to create documentation and original content resource material, with a particular focus on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents / Specifications (FRDs/FRSs).
* Extract and analyze data using several tools (ServiceNow, Excel, Python, Splunk, SQL, etc.)
* Gather data and perform analysis in a timely manner and verify the accuracy of results.
* Transform data analysis into information for broad audience consumption, including stakeholders .and senior management, leveraging appropriate visualization and presentation techniques to drive decisions.
* Assist Project Management with prioritization and tracking the implementation of system requirements.
* Assist Development and QA as a SME on market surveillance technology.
* Assist Product Management with roadmaps, initiatives, and vendor engagement.
* Assist Operations with incident management, resolution, and root cause analysis.
* Adhere to company cybersecurity and global policies; protect confidential customer information and the company’s intellectual property.
* Understand how the ICE markets, systems and technologies work.
* Occasionally assist in end user support activities (account administration, incident management and root cause analysis, and creating and maintaining business application / end user resources).
* Study new technology and remain technically current.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Development, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or related discipline.
* Must possess excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must be results\-oriented and self\-motivated.
* Must possess a good working knowledge of software testing and building high quality software.
* Must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio).
* Technical and functional business writing skills required.
* Detail\-oriented with demonstrated ability to write unambiguous requirements that do not imply design.
* Ability to effectively facilitate requirements gathering sessions, reviews and issue resolution involving multiple stakeholders.
* Demonstrates strong technical aptitude and understanding of how technologies impact delivery.
* Software product development, business analysis, quality assurance, or related experience highly preferable.
* Familiarity with Jira and Confluence preferable.

**Join us!**

jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 We are seeking an experienced, tech savvy Business Analyst with broad expertise in automation capabilities such as Artificial Intelligence (AI/ML), Intelligent Process Automation (IPA), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Process Mining and no\-code automation to join our Hyperautomation team. As a Business Analyst you will play a pivotal role in driving ideation, shaping the demand, ensuring our business creates tangible value from leveraging Hyperautomation and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**
* Engage with business leaders to create a shared understanding of how Hyperautomation, AI can enable them to improve efficiencies and add value.
* Collaborates with business stakeholder managers, business and IT leaders to create a multi\-year roadmap to solve business challenges through Hyperautomation.
* Drives creation and management of a pipeline of high value automation opportunities.
* Drive reusability of delivered solutions.
* Collaborate closely with Hyperautomation Enterprise and Solution architects to select the right platforms and tools to solve for the use case within our guidelines and standards, driving re\-use of investments, building on capabilities.
* Work with key stakeholders to ideate and refine use cases to automate business processes.
* Co\-create with the stakeholders the lean business case, analyze the current process, define the problem, scope, value and potential improvements and the to\-be process.
* Gather high level and detailed (non\-)functional requirements needed to deliver the use case through one or more automation solutions.
* Guide use cases from idea to value delivered, where needed acting as the key contact on behalf of the business and IT delivery teams and project managers.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure you can bring the ‘art of the possible’ ideas.
* Contribute to documentation for business cases, business processes, and automation solutions.
* Facilitate workshops and training sessions to educate business stakeholders on Hyperautomation and AI technologies, ensuring they understand the potential benefits and applications.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews to assess the impact of automation solutions and identify areas for further optimization.
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of implemented automation solutions, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.


**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in IT integration with a Bachelors Degree in engineering or MCA or MSc.
* Excellent communication skills, fluent spoken and written English.
* Proven experience in business analytics within IT, leveraging and combining multiple Hyperautomation capabilities.
* Very solid technical understanding of the broad set of Hyperautomation capabilities, combined with a deeper expert understanding in at least one or two of the Hyperautomation capabilities such as (Gen)AI, Process Mining or IPA/RPA, to spot and compare cross technology solutions to an automation opportunity.
* Solid problem\-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy ability to analyze complex process scenarios and offer solutions.
* High degree of interest in business processes improvement, with and automation mindset.
* A mindset of detail oriented, with cross\-Functional Collaboration, an eye for process Improvement.
* Understanding of systems, software and technological concepts, Familiarity with automation tools and data.
* Stance of the continuous learner with a passion for exploring new technologies and process optimization methodologies.
* Ability to work independently with general supervision on larger, moderately complex projects / assignments.
* Ability to set objectives for own job area to meet the objectives of projects and assignments.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related field.
* Proven ability to work as a team player, delivering quality results within defined timelines.


**Nice to have:**
* Experience in consultancy, pre\-sales.
* Experience in combining Robotic Process Automation with AI and Agentic AI platforms and solutions.
* Knowledge of capabilities in Snowflake, Databricks, Automation Anywhere, UI Path, WebMethods.
* Previous Medtronic experience, or experience in the Med Tech industry.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry\-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
   

  

 Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
* Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
* Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
* Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost\-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
* Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
* Lead business analysis activities for medium to large\-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
* Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies
* Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision\-making, and the ability to influence without authority
* Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* A patient\-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)
* Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI\-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)
* Training in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Background in implementing or optimizing clinical data management processes
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and facilitating decision\-making

jobs.title: Product Manager - Engagement
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 Kuku is India's one of the largest content platforms. This role owns the Engagement charter at Kuku — the cross\-functional function responsible for how often people come back, how deep they go, and how the product turns a first listen into a daily habit. You'll run the POD's roadmap end to end: dig into user behaviour, decide what to build next, and ship features that move engagement and retention. It's a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a cohort chart and in a prototype, and who can turn a hunch into something clickable before writing a single line of spec.
   

  

**What You'll Work OnOwn The Engagement POD**
* Own the engagement roadmap end to end — set the direction for the POD, decide what gets built, and drive it from idea to launch to iteration.
* Run the POD's day\-to\-day: define and prioritise the backlog, keep engineering and design unblocked, and make the calls that keep the squad moving.
* Own engagement and retention metrics for the POD, and be accountable for the number, not just the shipping.


**User Analysis \& Insight**
* Do the user analysis yourself — cohort, funnel, and retention analysis to understand where people drop off and why they come back.
* Combine quantitative data with qualitative research (user interviews, session reviews, feedback) to build a real picture of listener behaviour.
* Turn insight into a clear, prioritised view of what to build next.


**Feature Planning \& Prototyping**
* Plan new features from problem to spec — define the opportunity, size it, write crisp requirements, and align the POD around them.
* Vibe code your ideas. Use AI\-assisted coding and prototyping tools to build quick, working prototypes and clickable demos, so ideas get validated with real interaction before they hit the roadmap.
* Design and run experiments (A/B tests) to validate whether a feature actually moves the needle.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with engineering, design, data, and content to ship features that land.
* Communicate what you're building and why, and keep stakeholders aligned on outcomes over output.


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–6 years in product management, ideally on consumer products at real scale.
* Genuinely data\-driven — comfortable with product analytics, cohort and funnel analysis, and pulling your own numbers (SQL or tools like Amplitude / Mixpanel).
* Strong user\-research instinct — you talk to users and let evidence, not opinion, drive the roadmap.
* Vibe coding ability — you can use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, v0, or similar) to build prototypes and validate ideas hands\-on, without waiting on engineering.
* A track record of planning and shipping features that measurably improved engagement or retention.
* Clear thinking and clear communication — you can turn ambiguity into a plan the POD can execute.


**Good to have**
* Experience specifically on engagement, retention, growth, or habit\-formation problems.
* Experience with subscription, content, audio, or OTT products.
* Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing at scale.
* Comfort working across the funnel — onboarding, activation, and re\-engagement.


**Preferred Tools \& Technologies**
* Analytics: SQL, ClickHouse
* Prototyping / Vibe coding: Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma
* Experimentation: A/B testing and feature\-flag tooling


**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's in any discipline — or equivalent practical experience. What matters is judgement, curiosity, and a bias for shipping.


**What We Offer**
* Full ownership of a POD that directly moves the numbers that matter.
* Competitive comp \+ ESOPs.
* Learning budget and certification support.
* A team that cares about outcomes, not just output.

 Founded in 2018, KUKU is India’s leading storytelling platform, offering a vast digital library of audio stories, short courses, and microdramas. KUKU aims to be India’s largest cultural exporter of stories, culture, and history to the world with a firm belief in “Create In India, Create For The World”.
   

  

 We deliver immersive entertainment and education through our OTT platforms: Kuku FM, Guru, Kuku TV, and more. With a mission to provide high\-quality, personalized stories across genres from entertainment across multiple formats and languages, KUKU continues to push boundaries and redefine India’s entertainment industry.

jobs.description:
Role: Product Manager
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

**About The Function**
 Ground Transport is one of the fastest growing businesses at MakeMyTrip, serving millions of travellers across Bus, Rail and Cab journeys. The business plays a critical role in expanding travel accessibility across India, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, while delivering seamless, affordable and reliable mobility experiences.
   

  

 As travel behaviours evolve, Ground Transport is reimagining the booking and travel experience enabled with AI\-first product innovation. From personalized recommendations to conversational booking journeys, automated customer assistance and real\-time decision systems, we are building the next generation of travel experiences at scale.
   

  

 The Ground Transport team combines deep consumer understanding, data\-driven decision making and cutting\-edge technology to solve complex traveller problems across the entire journey lifecycle. Product managers, business leaders, engineers, designers and data scientists work together to build experiences that delight customers and drive meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Product Manager to define and scale the next generation of consumer experiences across Ground Transport. This role requires strong product thinking, execution excellence and a passion for solving customer problems through technology, data and AI.
   

  

 You will own the product vision, roadmap and execution for key Ground Transport experiences, working closely with cross\-functional teams to build products that improve customer engagement, conversion, retention and overall traveller satisfaction.
   

  

 What will you be doing
   

  

* Consumer Product \+ Growth \+ Data Science \+ AI\-powered Experiences
* 0\-to\-1 Innovation and 1\-to\-N Scaling
* Customer Understanding \+ Data\-Driven Decision Making
* You will identify high\-impact opportunities, rapidly validate solutions, and scale products that create measurable value for both customers and the business.
* Define and execute the product vision, strategy and roadmap for key Ground Transport customer experiences.
* Identify high\-impact customer and business problems across discovery, booking and traveller engagement journeys, and translate them into scalable product opportunities.
* Build AI\-powered and data\-driven experiences that improve trip planning, booking confidence and personalization.
* Drive rapid experimentation, prototyping and validation of new concepts before scaling them into production\-ready products.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Business, Analytics and Data Science teams to build accurate, scalable and impactful solutions.
* Define clear hypotheses, success metrics and measurement frameworks for product initiatives.
* Own product KPIs and continuously improve performance through experimentation, customer feedback and data analysis.
* Leverage customer insights, behavioural data and market intelligence to shape product strategy and prioritization.
* Balance short\-term business goals with long\-term platform and product investments.
* Lead end\-to\-end execution from concept to launch and post\-launch optimization.


 Qualification \& Experience
   

  

* Engineering \& Management graduates from reputed institutes with 3 to 4 years of experience in product management roles for consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled businesses.
* Experience managing the complete product lifecycle using agile methodologies including requirement definition, prioritization, user experience design and metric tracking.
* Experience working with complex datasets using analytical tools and techniques. Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and SQL is expected.
* Prior experience with product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude or Mixpanel will be an added advantage.
* Experience in travel, mobility, e\-commerce or marketplace businesses.
* Exposure to ML or GenAI\-powered customer experiences.
* Experience with personalization, recommendation systems or conversational interfaces.
* Experience working with large\-scale consumer products serving millions of users.


 Key Success Factors for the Role
   

  

* A passion for solving complex customer problems through technology, data and innovation.
* Strong product thinking with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured product solutions.
* Deep curiosity about emerging ML and GenAI capabilities and their application in creating superior customer experiences.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work with large datasets and make data\-driven decisions.
* Good understanding of technology systems and how technical decisions influence product outcomes and scalability.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across business, engineering, design, analytics and leadership teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from ideation to execution.

jobs.title: Product Manager - UPI
jobs.description:
**About Company:** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we are building a better alternative to credit cards that lets consumers buy now and pay later for a wide variety of products, be it shoes, clothes, fashion accessories, clothes or mobile phones. We firmly believe that an enduring financial services business must be built on the bedrock of providing honest, transparent and fair terms.
 



  





 Founded in 2017, today we are the leading online zero\-cost EMI provider in India. We have served over 10M consumers across 2,200 cities and are doubling year on year. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs and alumni of IIT Bombay and ISB with over two decades of experience across leading organizations like Swiggy, Oyo, Maruti Suzuki and ZS Associates before successfully scaling and exiting businesses in patent analytics, ad\-tech and bank\-tech software services
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager – UPI to improve the end\-to\-end UPI payment journey for Snapmint users. You will focus on reducing payment friction, improving transaction success rates, simplifying customer flows, and enhancing the overall payment experience across app and web platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about customer\-centric product development, payments, and data\-driven problem solving.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




 • Own the UPI customer journey from payment initiation to confirmation, refunds, and support flows.
 



 • Identify and resolve customer pain points, drop\-offs, failed transaction scenarios, and usability issues.
 



 • Work closely with engineering, design, operations, customer support, and analytics teams to deliver high\-quality payment experiences.
 



 • Analyze payment funnel metrics, transaction success rates, latency, retry behavior, and customer feedback to drive improvements.
 



 • Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics for UPI related features.
 



 • Collaborate with payment partners and internal stakeholders to improve reliability, reconciliation visibility, and customer communication.
 



 • Run A/B tests and experiments to optimize conversion and customer satisfaction.
 



 • Ensure that UPI flows comply with NPCI and RBI guidelines while maintaining a smooth user experience.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 • 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably in fintech, digital payments, banking, BNPL, or consumer internet products.
 



 • Strong understanding of UPI payment flows, including Collect, Intent, QR, and payment status handling.
 



 • Experience working with cross\-functional teams in an agile product environment.
 



 • Ability to use data and customer insights to prioritize product improvements.
 



 • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**The Role**
 This is a generalist PM role, not a specialist one. In the same week you might be writing a PRD, sitting in a sprint planning session, and on a call with a university administrator trying to understand why a feature isn't landing. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Sales, and you're expected to make calls independently and explain your reasoning clearly — whether you're talking to an engineer or a customer who has never used a product roadmap tool in their life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product roadmap for your area — weighing what customers are asking for against business priorities and what's actually feasible to build.
* Speak regularly with university administrators, wardens, operations teams, and other stakeholders to gather structured customer feedback.
* Analyse product usage data to identify friction points and recommend product improvements.
* Prioritise features based on customer demand, business impact, and strategic goals.
* Define product requirements and collaborate with Design and Engineering teams to ship impactful features.
* Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to identify expansion opportunities and improve customer outcomes.
* Own delivery end to end — scoping, sprint planning, execution, QA, and getting it live — not just handing off a spec and moving on.
* Make the calls that need making, even with incomplete information, and be ready to walk engineers and customers through your reasoning.
* Sit in on sprint planning and backlog grooming with Engineering and Design, and clear blockers when the team needs it.
* Keep an eye on product quality after launch — triage what breaks, and push fixes through with Engineering.
* Track the metrics that actually matter (usage, adoption, satisfaction) and let them shape what you prioritise next.


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–6 years in Product Management, ideally in enterprise or B2B SaaS.
* A real track record of owning a product area start to finish, not just contributing to one someone else owns.
* You write clearly — PRDs make sense to engineers, and you can hold your own explaining a decision to a customer who isn't technical.
* You're comfortable being the person customers talk to directly, and honest with them about what the product can and can't do yet.
* You make decisions. Even without full information, you're willing to call it and own what happens next.
* You know Agile/Scrum well enough to run with it — sprint planning, backlog grooming, release management, the whole cycle.
* You can hold customer requests, business goals, and engineering constraints in your head at once, and explain the trade\-offs without getting defensive.
* You're fine with startup pace — less structure, more ownership, figuring things out as you go.
* You'd rather ship something real than keep polishing a deck about it.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working in B2B SaaS products.
* EdTech or enterprise software experience.
* Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with SQL and data analysis.
* Time spent with enterprise or institutional customers, where sales cycles and rollouts run longer than usual.
* Have run product experiments or A/B tests before — not essential here, but a bonus.
* Spent time at an early\-stage startup where resources were tight and you just had to make it work.

jobs.description:
**Job Title**
 Product Owner
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Product Owner serves as the primary product authority and trusted advisor for airline clients adopting the mobile application (iOS and Android). This role owns the end\-to\-end mobile product experience for each client — translating their business goals, branding, and operational needs into a tailored, well\-prioritized mobile app backlog. Working closely with airline client stakeholders on one side and internal mobile design, engineering, and delivery teams on the other, the Product Owner ensures each airline's mobile application drives passenger engagement and commercial value. Success is measured by client satisfaction, on\-time delivery of mobile releases, and the business results the app generates for each airline.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Client Engagement \& Relationship Management
   

  

* Act as the main mobile product point of contact for one or more airline clients throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client product, commercial, digital, and operations stakeholders.
* Run discovery workshops to understand each airline's mobile experience objectives, passenger journey goals, and operational constraints.
* Manage client expectations on mobile app scope, timelines, and trade\-offs; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly.


 Requirements \& Mobile Backlog Ownership
   

  

* Capture, analyze, and translate client requirements into clear mobile app user stories with well\-defined acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the client\-specific mobile product backlog, balancing client requests against platform capabilities and the broader mobile roadmap.
* Distinguish between standard/configurable mobile features and custom development, advising clients on the most efficient path.
* Make data\-informed trade\-off decisions and negotiate mobile feature priorities with clients when demand exceeds capacity.


 Mobile Solution Delivery \& Configuration
   

  

* Guide clients through configuration of core mobile app capabilities: flight search \& booking, check\-in, boarding passes, seat selection, baggage, flight status, push notifications, and disruption handling.
* Oversee branding, localization, and client\-specific business rules within the mobile application.
* Coordinate integration of the mobile app with the airline's systems (PSS/GDS, loyalty, payment gateways, operational data feeds).
* Support ancillary and loyalty feature enablement on mobile to drive client revenue.


 Cross\-Functional Coordination (Internal)
   

  

* Bridge client needs and internal Agile mobile delivery teams; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and mobile app demos.
* Collaborate with mobile UX/UI, engineering, QA, and delivery/project managers to ensure committed features are delivered to quality.
* Channel recurring or high\-value client requests into the core mobile product roadmap as candidate platform features.


 Mobile Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define mobile success metrics with each client (app adoption, conversion, ancillary attach rate, NPS/CSAT, app store rating).
* Use mobile analytics and client feedback to recommend enhancements and demonstrate value realization.
* Conduct post\-release reviews and mobile roadmap planning sessions with clients.


 Governance, Compliance \& Quality
   

  

* Ensure delivered mobile solutions meet aviation regulations, accessibility (WCAG), data privacy (GDPR/PCI\-DSS), and app store guidelines.
* Maintain clear documentation of mobile app client commitments, decisions, and configuration choices.

We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

jobs.description:
**Senior Business Analyst**
Healthcare Domain \| PBM Experience Preferred


Experience 6 to 8 Years  

Cost : 20 LPA
Position Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with a strong healthcare background to serve as the bridge between business needs and technology delivery. The ideal candidate will be skilled in eliciting, analyzing, and documenting requirements; facilitating stakeholder alignment; and supporting implementation of healthcare technology solutions across the software development lifecycle. Experience in Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) is highly desirable.  


Key Responsibilities

* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, solution architects, developers, QA teams, and project managers to define business objectives and solution outcomes.
* Plan and facilitate workshops, interviews, discovery sessions, and process walkthroughs to understand current\-state workflows, pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, use cases, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain high\-quality BRDs, FRDs, workflow diagrams, decision logs, requirement traceability matrices, and supporting project documentation.
* Analyze current business processes and recommend improvements that optimize operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve stakeholder experience.
* Support Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, story elaboration, estimation support, and sprint reviews.
* Collaborate throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure requirements are understood, solution design is aligned, and delivery outcomes meet business intent.
* Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), define test scenarios, validate results against requirements, triage defects, and support business sign\-off.
* Manage requirement traceability from business objectives through solution design, development, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Support change management, training material development, release readiness, and operational documentation as needed.
* Ensure solutions and documentation align with healthcare regulations, organizational standards, data privacy expectations, and compliance requirements.


Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, including at least 5 years in the healthcare industry.
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder interviews, requirements analysis, process modeling, and functional documentation.
* Hands\-on experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Proficiency with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Visio, Microsoft Office, and BPMN/UML modeling tools.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, written communication, verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams, product leadership, technology teams, operational users, and executive stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

* **PBM experience:** Knowledge of pharmacy claims, formulary management, prior authorization, rebate management, specialty pharmacy, and eligibility and benefits.
* **Healthcare data standards:** Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, and healthcare interoperability concepts.
* **Data skills:** Experience with SQL, data analysis, reporting, metrics interpretation, and operational dashboards is an advantage.
* **Certifications:** CBAP, PMI\-PBA, Agile, Scrum, or related business analysis certifications are preferred.


Desired Skills

* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, and facilitation skills.
* Strong documentation, presentation, and storytelling abilities.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear, testable, and actionable functional specifications.
* Critical thinking and structured problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing timelines.
* Self\-driven, collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.


Nice to Have

* PBM implementation, migration, or modernization project experience.
* Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial health plans.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based healthcare platforms, data platforms, and AI\-enabled healthcare solutions.


Experience contributing to healthcare digital transformation initiatives.

BE

3

6

 The Product Business Analyst supports the development of straight\-through processing (STP) solutions that integrate with third\-party vendors associated with our clients, such as data providers, trade affirmation platforms, fund administrators, prime brokers, and custodians. The team is primarily focused on building data ingestion and export interfaces.
   

  

**The Role:**
 This role reports to the India TPR Lead. As a product business analyst, you will contribute to building data ingestion and transmission interfaces, enhancing the team’s domain expertise and promoting best practices. You will engage with a broad range of stakeholders across the financial services industry, including hedge funds, institutional asset managers, prime brokers, custodians, fund administrators and analytics service providers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Partner with internal client\-facing teams, third parties (e.g., hedge funds, institutional asset managers, prime brokers, custodians, fund administrators, and analytics service providers), and internal technology teams to enable straight\-through processing within our portfolio management solution. This includes supporting the data ingestion and transmission.
* Leverage your in\-depth understanding of the multi\-asset class investment management process to define clear requirements, design solutions, and create holistic test plans.
* Ensure new projects or enhancement requests from clients and internal stakeholders (E.g. Sales, account managers, client success teams) are handled promptly and appropriately.
* Communicate regularly with the development team to provide guidance on the enhancements required and its prioritization.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, and external third parties to comprehensively test new interfaces.
* Document new developments, as well as cross\-train the team and other relevant internal stakeholders about exciting product releases.
* Oversee strategic roadmap initiatives with minimal supervision and independently deliver results through collaboration across all relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in complex projects which require a strong technical acumen, expertise, and critical thinking \- specifically in data management, connectivity and process architecture.
* Build new and/or improve existing broker relationships through mutual value propositions that benefit both counterparties and support company\-wide initiatives.
